theme_and_archetype.rationale: For a real-time logistics and ride management dashboard, the Swiss High-Contrast archetype in a dark theme ensures functional clarity, reduces eye strain during long sessions or night driving, and highlights critical data efficiently.

mono.usage: Use exclusively for metric numbers, ride IDs, timestamps, and live coordinates.

layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: MODE B: 'Control Room' Grid. Strict hierarchy, gap-4 to gap-6. Use col-span-1 for summary widgets, col-span-2 or col-span-3 for maps and charts.
layout_and_spacing.padding_scale: Use generous padding: p-6 or p-8 inside cards, p-4 on smaller widgets.
layout_and_spacing.corners: Subtle roundness, max 8px (rounded-md or rounded-lg). No exaggerated pills.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Left-align dense tabular data and forms. Center-align empty states or broad summary numbers.

cards.style: Flat background, 1px solid border (border-zinc-800), no shadows on default state.

buttons.primary: bg-[#FFB800] text-black font-semibold rounded-md hover:bg-[#E5A600] transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-zinc-800 text-white border border-zinc-700 hover:bg-zinc-700 hover:text-white

forms.inputs: bg-zinc-900 border-zinc-800 text-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#FFB800] focus:border-transparent
forms.labels: text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-zinc-400 mb-1 block

map.tile_layer: MUST use a dark tile layer for seamless dark UI integration: url='https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/dark_all/{z}/{x}/{y}{r}.png'
map.markers: Use solid brand colors (Amber/Yellow for Driver, Blue for Passenger).

navigation.sidebar: Fixed, dense vertical sidebar for driver/admin dashboards. border-r border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-950.

visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the skeleton. Use grid borders to separate data cleanly without wrapping everything in isolated cards.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react. Duotone or Regular weight for legibility.
visual_enhancers.textures: Minimal. Stick to matte finishes. No gradients except for heatmap data points on maps.

motion.micro_interactions: Hover states must explicitly declare background and text colors (e.g. hover:bg-zinc-800 hover:text-white).
motion.transitions: Use specific properties: transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text on maps has a solid backdrop or heavy text-shadow. Normal text must be at least 4.5:1 against #09090B.
accessibility.focus: All actionable items must have a visible focus state, e.g. focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[#FFB800] focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-zinc-950.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='request-ride-button').

image_urls.description: Historic university courtyard at night - Use as a cinematic full-bleed background for the Passenger/Driver Login and Registration pages.
Auto rickshaw at night - Use as a placeholder for driver profile or vehicle images in the dashboard.
Tuk tuks on street - Use if there is a landing/marketing page before entering the app.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. DEPENDENCIES: Install @phosphor-icons/react for all iconography. Use 'recharts' for demand analytics charts. Install 'react-leaflet' and 'leaflet' for map components.
2. TYPOGRAPHY: Inject the Fontshare and Google Fonts links provided in typography into index.html.

3. SHADCN SETUP: Use pure HTML/Tailwind for macro-layouts (the 'Control Room' grid). Use Shadcn components for complex interactions (Forms, Select, Dialog, Tables) but heavily customize them. Strip default borders/shadows to match the 'Cards' and 'Forms' rules defined here.
4. MAP UI: When integrating Leaflet, it is CRITICAL to use the CartoDB Dark Matter tile layer so it doesn't blind the user with white map tiles.
5. DATA-TESTID: Enforce 'data-testid' on every form input, button, and navigation link (e.g. data-testid='driver-online-toggle').
6. SPACING: Rely on CSS Grid with gap-4 or gap-6 for dashboards. Avoid deep nesting of divs when possible.
7. WEBSOCKETS: For real-time state changes, represent loading/syncing states with subtle Phosphor icon spinners or skeleton loaders in dark grey (bg-zinc-800).
